description: PyCharm professional Python development: Virtualenv / Conda / Poetry environment synchronization, visual interactive debugger with variable introspection, profiling with cProfile, and Django/FastAPI support.
instructionsMarkdown:
# PyCharm Professional Python Development & Profiling

Configure and optimize PyCharm for high-velocity Python backend engineering and scientific workflows.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Bind projects to isolated virtual environments managed by Poetry, Pipenv, or Conda.
- Standardize the project test runner to `pytest` in IDE settings.
- Integrate Mypy/Ruff inspections to catch typing and style violations before commit.
- Secure database tool connections using SSH tunnels and environment-variable credentials.
